scope: R0 isolated Web compatibility after MA24 migrations 127-134

aclRecoveryForIsolatedSmoke.finding: The custom backup excluded ACLs. Before restoring route-specific effective privileges, old Web synthetic login returned 500; PostgreSQL reported missing auth_login_attempt_id_seq privilege. Login then passed, but upload list returned 503 until the joined knowledge tables had their source-equivalent privileges.
aclRecoveryForIsolatedSmoke.temporaryCloneGrants: Only effective source-role privileges on four authentication/upload tables, three list-join tables, the login sequence, app_current_user_id and public schema were copied to the disposable clone.

limits: This proves only the listed authentication, authorization and empty-list routes against one migrated disposable clone.
No actual upload review, Skill evidence, Graph, worker, natural business task or source revocation was exercised.
No product port or database was switched. Service rollback after production traffic and any database write remains unverified.
